Calamus Extract essential oil
I had a bottle of this lying around the lab (I was an amature cosmetic manufacturer at the time) because its used in perfumery for its scent which is very musky.  I read on the internet that its like speed and a psychodelic mixed in one.  I read that indians chew on the root and can run for miles.  So I get the bright idea of taking 2 or 3 drops of the extract in a glass of water to see what would happend.  I guess I was thinking I might be inspired to run around the block tripping balls and playing and skipping like I was 5 years old.
What really happened is this I waited around for about a half an hour and then puked my ass off all day.  I was totally incompasitated and curled up in bed for about 15 hours.  It doesn't work and it made me sick!
